storage_folder.title: Storage folder
storage_folder.description: Path to the folder where collections are stored

conversion_bday_summary_template.title: Birthday summary template
conversion_bday_summary_template.description: Template for the summary of converted birthday events. Supports placeholders: {name}, {first}, {last}, {age}

conversion_bday_description_template.title: Birthday description template
conversion_bday_description_template.description: Template for the description of converted birthday events. Supports placeholders: {name}, {first}, {last}, {age}
conversion_bday_description_template.default: Happy Birthday {first}! You are now {age} years old.

conversion_bday_age_max.title: Birthday max age
conversion_bday_age_max.description: Maximum age to generate separate events for. Set to 0 for standard yearly recurrence (recommended to avoid 'Multiple main components' error). If > 0, generates one event per year up to this age.

conversion_bday_alarm_trigger_template.title: Birthday alarm trigger
conversion_bday_alarm_trigger_template.description: Alarm trigger for birthday events (e.g., 'PT-1H' for 1 hour before). Use $ to separate multiple alarms. Supports placeholders in description.

conversion_bday_categories.title: Birthday calendar categories
conversion_bday_categories.description: Comma-separated list of calendar categories for birthday events
